mapper.insert:
insert into CBONDANALYSISSHC (OBJECT_ID, S_INFO_WINDCODE, TRADE_DT, B_ANAL_MATU_CNBD, B_ANAL_DIRTY_CNBD, B_ANAL_ACCRINT_CNBD, B_ANAL_NET_CNBD, B_ANAL_YIELD_CNBD, B_ANAL_MODIDURA_CNBD, B_ANAL_CNVXTY_CNBD, B_ANAL_VOBP_CNBD, B_ANAL_SPRDURA_CNBD, B_ANAL_SPRCNXT_CNBD, B_ANAL_PRICE, B_ANAL_NETPRICE, B_ANAL_YIELD, B_ANAL_MODIFIEDDURATION, B_ANAL_CONVEXITY, B_ANAL_BPVALUE, B_ANAL_SDURATION, B_ANAL_SCNVXTY, B_ANAL_INTERESTDURATION_CNBD, B_ANAL_INTERESTCNVXTY_CNBD, B_ANAL_INTERESTDURATION, B_ANAL_INTERESTCNVXTY, B_ANAL_PRICE_CNBD, B_ANAL_BPYIELD, B_ANAL_SURPLUSCAPITAL, B_ANAL_EXCHANGE, B_ANAL_CREDIBILITY, OPDATE, OPMODE ) values
(#{item.objectId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.sInfoWindcode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.tradeDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.bAnalMatuCnbd,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalDirtyCnbd,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalAccrintCnbd,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalNetCnbd,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalYieldCnbd,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalModiduraCnbd,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalCnvxtyCnbd,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalVobpCnbd,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalSprduraCnbd,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalSprcnxtCnbd,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalPrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalNetprice,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalYield,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalModifiedduration,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalConvexity,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalBpvalue,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalSduration,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalScnvxty,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalInterestdurationCnbd,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalInterestcnvxtyCnbd,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalInterestduration,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalInterestcnvxty,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalPriceCnbd,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalBpyield,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalSurpluscapital,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalExchange,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{item.bAnalCredibility,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.opdate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{item.opmode,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: select A.OBJECT_ID, A.S_INFO_WINDCODE, date_format(STR_TO_DATE(A.TRADE_DT,'%Y%m%d'),'%Y-%m-%d') TRADE_DT, A.B_ANAL_MATU_CNBD, A.B_ANAL_DIRTY_CNBD, A.B_ANAL_ACCRINT_CNBD, A.B_ANAL_NET_CNBD, ifnull(A.B_ANAL_YIELD_CNBD/100,NULL) B_ANAL_YIELD_CNBD, A.B_ANAL_MODIDURA_CNBD, A.B_ANAL_CNVXTY_CNBD, A.B_ANAL_VOBP_CNBD, A.B_ANAL_SPRDURA_CNBD, A.B_ANAL_SPRCNXT_CNBD, A.B_ANAL_PRICE, A.B_ANAL_NETPRICE, ifnull(A.B_ANAL_YIELD/100,NULL) B_ANAL_YIELD, A.B_ANAL_MODIFIEDDURATION, A.B_ANAL_CONVEXITY, A.B_ANAL_BPVALUE, A.B_ANAL_SDURATION, A.B_ANAL_SCNVXTY, A.B_ANAL_INTERESTDURATION_CNBD, A.B_ANAL_INTERESTCNVXTY_CNBD, A.B_ANAL_INTERESTDURATION, A.B_ANAL_INTERESTCNVXTY, A.B_ANAL_PRICE_CNBD, A.B_ANAL_BPYIELD, A.B_ANAL_SURPLUSCAPITAL, A.B_ANAL_EXCHANGE, A.B_ANAL_CREDIBILITY, A.OPDATE,A.OPMODE from CBONDANALYSISSHC A WHERE EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM FIN_PRODUCT B WHERE B.FINPROD_TYPE='F01' AND A.S_INFO_WINDCODE = B.FINPROD_MARKET_ID ) AND A.TRADE_DT = #{cdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
